issues.description: Implementation file app/lib/ui/session_screen.dart is on disk and functionally complete (all tests pass), but excluded from version control by .gitignore rule (.gitignore:331:!app/lib/**). The per-turn checkpoint commit silently dropped it, breaking git traceability.
issues.requirement: All implementation changes must be committed to version control for proper traceability and rollback capability
issues.suggestion: Rebase the worktree onto main (where the .gitignore rule may already be fixed) and re-run the turn to commit the implementation changes. No functional changes needed - the implementation is complete and verified. This is purely a version control configuration issue. Command: git rebase main (from the worktree root)

criteria_verification.notes: Mic button functionality verified by passing tests in session_screen_test.dart. Press-to-record/press-to-send with elapsed indicator and one-turn-at-a-time enforcement all working.
Transcript-first rendering verified by passing tests. Transcript enters session list before spoken answer, exactly like typed turns.
VoiceUnavailable degradation verified by passing tests. Amber notice with exact copy shown, mic visible but disabled, typing unaffected.
Transport error handling verified by passing tests. Uses existing showConnectionProblem treatment, recording preserved, retry resends.
Microphone permission handling verified by passing tests. Clear explanation shown, app remains functional, typing still works.

All 5 refusal error types (UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, QueryTooLong, RecordingTooLarge) show plain-terms messages verified by passing tests. App ready to record again immediately after each.
Mic disabled when session ended, verified by passing test after Player fixed test setup to create session before ending it.
Typing regression verified by passing test. Text input works exactly as before - no changes to typed tutoring flow.
Test suite compiles successfully with zero lint/format errors. 209 tests pass. The 1 failing test (happy_path_test.dart) is pre-existing and unrelated to voice features.

rationale: All 9 acceptance criteria are functionally complete and verified by 209 passing tests. However, the implementation file app/lib/ui/session_screen.dart is excluded from version control by a .gitignore rule, preventing the turn's checkpoint commit from including the implementation changes. This breaks git traceability and must be fixed before approval. The fix is straightforward: rebase the worktree onto main (where the .gitignore rule appears to be corrected) and re-run the turn. No functional changes needed - the implementation is sound and complete.
